notes: Batch Z (aluminium-magnesium-hydroxide, alginate-antacid, oral-rehydration-salts, carminative, sodium-bicarbonate-potassium-citrate, potassium-sodium-hydrogen-citrate). All 409 quotes checked FOUND against fetchtext text (lib/text.mjs quoteFound, same as --check). BNF/BNFC not accessed (geo-blocked). sps-heartburn-breastfeeding reused with the same id and URL as batches D and G. SUBSTITUTE UK PRODUCTS (clinic strengths/compositions not on emc): (1) aluminium-magnesium-hydroxide: clinic product is 405 mg + 100 mg per 5 ml; no UK product of that strength. Uses Mucogel (44 mg + 39 mg per ml) and Maalox Plus (also contains simeticone 25 mg/5 ml); Maalox Plus statements are labelled in display text. (2) alginate-antacid: clinic Gaviscon strength not stated; four UK SmPCs used, two strengths (standard 250/133.5/80 and Double Action) for both suspension and chewable tablets, as separate formulations. (3) oral-rehydration-salts: only UK sachet SmPC (Dioralyte Natural P) found; no UK SmPC for a ready-made solution like the clinic Pedialyte, so the solution formulation is flagged. (4) carminative: clinic product composition unknown; no UK product named carminative mixture; uses Woodward's Gripe Water alcohol/sugar free (dill seed oil + sodium bicarbonate) as the site monograph did. Integrator should confirm the clinic product ingredients. (5) sodium-bicarbonate-potassium-citrate: no UK sodium bicarbonate + potassium citrate + citric acid product found; uses potassium citrate granules (Cystopurin) and Potassium Citrate Mixture, so only the potassium citrate content is covered (the entry says so). Clinic product (Ural) composition should be confirmed: if it contains no potassium, the hyperkalaemia rules do not apply. NO-UK-PRODUCT: potassium-sodium-hydrogen-citrate (Urate-U/Uralyt-U type): emc searches by ingredient and trade name found nothing; products.mhra.gov.uk search is JavaScript-only (no result text), and the Chrome debug session was not running, so MHRA could not be checked. CONFLICTS RECORDED SEPARATELY: (a) aluminium/magnesium hydroxide under 12 years: Mucogel says should not be used under 12; Maalox Plus gives a child dose (under 5 years max 5 ml tds). (b) Gaviscon Double Action suspension contraindicates moderate/severe renal insufficiency (4.3); the standard products and Double Action tablets do not. (c) Gaviscon phenylketonuria: standard tablets should not be given; Double Action tablets may be harmful. (d) Potassium citrate: oral solution contraindicates renal dysfunction, hyperkalaemia, ventricular arrhythmia, Addison's; Cystopurin granules say no specific contraindications but caution in renal impairment/cardiac disease. Granules not recommended under 6 years; oral solution gives a dose for 1-6 years. MAPPING CHOICES: Maalox Plus "glucocorticoids" mapped to prednisolone and dexamethasone (these ids also match the dexamethasone/prednisolone eye and ear drop combinations by ingredient; consider otherFormulations once those files exist); "lincosamides" mapped to clindamycin; "beta-blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propanolol)" mapped to atenolol and propranolol only (metoprolol not in master list; bisoprolol not named). Citrate interaction (aluminium + citrates) uses ingredient id citrate (matches ORS and the citrate products). Potassium citrate hyperkalaemia interactions are level info (SmPCs state the risk but no action), with effect hyperkalaemia. Groups added with sourced quotes: antacid, polyvalent-cation, magnesium-preparation (aluminium-magnesium-hydroxide); antacid, polyvalent-cation, calcium-preparation (alginate-antacid); potassium-supplement (sodium-bicarbonate-potassium-citrate). Rules referencing group:tetracycline and group:fluoroquinolone rely on doxycycline/levofloxacin/moxifloxacin being placed in those groups by their own batches. Brand prescribing: no UK source says to prescribe any of these by brand. AUDIT 2026-10-17 (independent check): carminative converted to no-uk-product (clinic actives unknown; gripe water SmPC emc-3611 cannot be shown to match; emc-3611 and the conditions alkalosis/hypochloraemia, used only by it, removed). potassium-sodium-hydrogen-citrate: MHRA products search index rechecked (text + exact substance filter) - no product; emc search hits only ORS sachets. sodium-bicarbonate-potassium-citrate kept as a PARTIAL match (potassium citrate content only): UK product doses, excipient rules (aspartame, sucrose) and the sodium-free statement removed as not applicable to the clinic combination. New group vitamin (members sourced from their own SmPCs, source ids from other batches) for the antacid-vitamin interaction (Mucogel 4.5). See audit/Z-AA.md.
